scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix api --ignore-scripts && npm install --prefix webapp --ignore-scripts
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,electron -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix api" "npm run dev:local --prefix webapp"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix api" "npm run dev:local --prefix webapp"
